code.description: Letters, digits, '-' or '_'; case-insensitive, stored upper case.

account_reference.description: Who the affiliate is on the platform; a buyer with the same reference is never credited for their own purchase.

delta.description: Change of on hand stock; never zero.

cap_amount.description: Most one sale pays, in minor units; absent is no cap.

hold_days.description: How long a commission waits before it is the affiliate's; cover the return window.

rate_basis_points.description: Share of the order subtotal: 500 is 5%.

window_days.description: How long after the touch a sale is still credited.

residue.description: Apportionment method, when the discount was over the whole basket.
Apportionment method, when the discount was over the whole basket (DEC-FIN-003).

daily_limit.description: AI requests the store may make per UTC day.

provider.description: The adapter that will answer, such as anthropic.

category_path.description: The catalogue category; the full path comes with the draft.

id.description: The catalogue id, to request a draft with.

price_minor.description: The lowest catalogue price in centavos of BRL, for reference.

thumbnail.description: For recognising the product only; not for publishing.

store_categories.description: The names of the store categories the product is in now.

tone.description: Such as profissional, descontraído or técnico.

gtin.description: The EAN/GTIN barcode, when the catalogue has it.

category_id.description: One of the store's existing categories.

taxonomy_id.description: The Google taxonomy id of the path, or of its deepest verified ancestor.

taxonomy_path.description: The path in the Google or Meta product taxonomy.

value.description: The text, for a text field.

verified.description: Whether the taxonomy path was found in the embedded taxonomy. An unverified path is the model's text.

abandon_at.description: When the cart is abandoned if left unchanged. Any change pushes it out.

expire_at.description: When the cart expires, counted from creation.

promotion_ruleset_version.description: The store's promotion ruleset the discounts were computed against.

promotions.description: Promotions applied now, with the discount each granted.

ready.description: True when every line is sellable, priced and in stock right now.

subtotal_amount.description: Sum of priced lines before discounts, in minor units. Informative: checkout recalculates.

store_id.description: Absent for a marketplace channel, which every store sells on.

code.description: Stable identifier inside its owner's namespace.
Upper-cased. Whether it is worth anything is answered by the promotions in the cart's view.

budget_amount.description: Total discount the promotion may grant, in minor units.

exclusive.description: Applies alone: nothing before, nothing after.

max_uses_per_buyer.description: How often one buyer may redeem it; a basket with no buyer never gets a promotion that has this.

buyer_reference.description: Opaque reference of the buyer in the caller's system. The customer account model is DEC-ID-001.

channel_id.description: The sales channel, one of the store's sellable channels. Copied to the order.

priority.description: Lower is tried first by the priority strategy. Defaults to 100.

expected_version.description: Refuse the change with 409 when the product has another version.

set_validity.description: When true, valid_from and valid_until replace both bounds; omitted bounds become open.

discounts.description: Discount per variant, in minor units.

location.description: Where the error occurred, such as body.name or query.limit.

alt.description: What a screen reader announces. Empty means decorative.
What a screen reader announces. Empty means decorative.

upload_url.description: PUT exactly the declared bytes here with the declared Content-Type, before expires_at. Absent when the store already holds this content.

content_type.description: One of the accepted types (DEC-MEDIA-004). Verified against the content at finalize.

discount_amount.description: What promotions take off this line now.

listed_at.description: When the product was first listed; an edit does not move it.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; absent on the last one.

status.description: Always ok while the process can serve requests.

attachment.description: True when the URL is served for download, never inline.

content_type.description: The type detected from the content once uploaded; the declared one before.

url.description: Immutable public URL when published, a short-lived signed URL when private; absent when nothing is servable.

source_cart_id.description: The cart folded into this one; it is left merged.

currency.description: ISO 4217. Every price of the list is in it.

priority.description: 0 to 1000. The highest applicable priority wins; ties make the price ambiguous.

version.description: Changes with the list and with every price in it.

request_id.description: Request identifier for support and tracing.

title.description: Short summary of the problem type.

images.description: The gallery, ordered. The first is what a listing shows.

variants.description: Present when reading a single product.

max_uses_per_buyer.description: How often one buyer may redeem it; absent means only the overall limit applies.

quantity.description: For min_quantity, over the matching lines.

kind.description: Order-level effects are blocked until DEC-FIN-003 fixes the residue method.

ambiguous.description: Variants whose highest-priority applicable lists tie; they have no price.

at.description: Instant the validity of lists was evaluated at.

status.description: ready when every dependency is up.

reason.description: Why it was refused; the buyer can be shown this.

seller_order_id.description: The purchase behind it, when the review names one.

index_lag_ms.description: How far behind the projection was: what this answer may not know yet. Search never gives transactional truth (02 §Search).

total.description: How many documents matched, as the engine counted them.

price_amount.description: Minor units of the list currency.

buyer_reference.description: The account writing it. It must have a delivered order of this product.
The account that wrote it. Only its author withdraws a review.

bearer.description: Access token from the approved OpenID Connect provider.
